notes.title: 'Hot Potato' Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/7fa1644c4abe5183585191fd7a6f0b329010f452.jpg[/img]

Update 1.07 features two new boulders and some general improvements. By popular demand, the [b]Paint Boulder[/b] from Rock of Ages 2 is back and we're introducing the explosive '[b]Hot Potato[/b]' to the series. Other notable improvements include Polish support (special thanks to [i]Kuba "Mr.Kuabster" Dębiec[/i] for producing the localization).

[u]Full list of changes[/u]:

[list]
[*] Added Hot Potato boulder (unlockable at the world map with 15 stars).
[*] Added Paint Boulder (unlockable at the world map with 30 stars).
[*] Added Polish language (Known issue: font sheet is not supporting some special characters. We'll try to fix this in a future update).
[*] Fixed particle spamming issue in the world map that could lead to a crash.
[*] Fixed glitch at the end of credits.
[*] Fixed duplicated SFXs with some boulder explosions.
[*] Converted Original Soundtrack to 'Music Depot'; OST can now be downloaded independently from the Library.
[*] PhysX stability improvements.
[/list]

We hope everyone enjoys these new updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/246b2b48dbe2b48f84b454d95b7b0106c020f251.png[/img]

And yet another patch that mainly focuses on stability and performance issues. We've tackled a few more problems that were leading to potential crashes while still working on a few extra improvements. Check out the patch details to learn more information about this update.

[u]The full list of updates are here[/u]:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash caused by boiling oil cauldrons.
[*] Optimized boiling oil cauldron animations so they don't affect performance as much.
[*] Potential fix for PhysX contact generation crash.
[*] Avalanche AI boulders break when they hit the castle door so they don't block other boulders that are also trying to reach their target.
[*] Delayed win in Spaghettiland Unit Challenge is fixed.
[*] Fixed some unresponsive Editor inputs.
[*] Fixed arrows not aligning correctly during Napoleon's tutorial.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more changes in upcoming revisions!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/246b2b48dbe2b48f84b454d95b7b0106c020f251.png[/img]

This patch addresses more issues while introducing a re-designed version of ‘Cyclopean Isles - War’ that replaces the old layout. We’ll continue to swap some of the old levels with new more interesting designs in upcoming updates.


[u]The full list of updates is here[/u]:

[list]
[*] Potential fix for physics crash.
[*] Difficulty levels are operating again (select from options menu).
[*] Apex destructibles optimizations for newly introduced destructible meshes. 
[*] Unit challenge no longer fails to populate layout with obstacles if player presses retry.
[*] Music doesn't cut off after pressing restart in Time Trial. 
[*] New level design for Cyclopean Isles - War.
[*] Dragon upgrade localization restored.
[*] Dragon boss executes slow motion only on first hit.
[/list]

Notes on the new level by the author (Carlos Bordeu - ACE Team):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/0d5a564f857a40424e2557d9f18c6cddbfc92a39.jpg[/img]

[i]The original map, while interesting with the cannons, was showing very little of the new content of RoA3, felt too large for an introductory map, and was more in the style of an Obstacle Race. I designed the map with the War game mode in mind, giving the level a couple of shortcuts, some alternate paths, and some interesting areas where Mines are placed - but always keeping things simple (it is the first War map after all). I also designed the level to have several areas with steps - something I feel that breaks from the monotony of simple paths. All this was done with the editor which definitely allows for endless options. Looking forward to diving into it again.[/i]

---

We hope everyone enjoys this update and stay tuned for more content coming soon.

notes.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/a6a1e3cac6eedb17bef790f902de6fbc80e67494.jpg[/img]

Whether this is your introduction to the series or its triumphant return, [i]Rock of Ages 3[/i] is the biggest and [i]bouldest[/i] entry yet, and I’m here to walk you through everything you can make and break today!

[h3]What is Rock of Ages?[/h3]

[i]Rock of Ages[/i] is a blend of tower defense strategy, arcade action, and competitive racing wrapped up in one giant destructive bundle. Players control a multitude of different boulders as they storm the opponent’s stronghold, while simultaneously placing a variety of defenses, traps, and structures to defend your own castle from siege.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/577c7a254683612c217dc31b8a0eabe8d7948454.jpg[/img]

When you’re done busting down castle doors, there are five more skill-based game modes for you to challenge progressively more difficult computer-controlled opponents or other players in online and local multiplayer.

[h3]The MAKE Mode[/h3]

In a series first, ACE Team is giving players the tools they need to create their own wacky courses, share online, and play them with others. This easy-to-use level editor supports all the different game modes and boulders, and you can download and play the variety of courses made by the community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/8a72eb5b601a79eb89fde6a0ca332b9baae5cb4c.jpg[/img]

[h3]The BREAK Mode[/h3]

When you are done making your levels it’s time to break everyone else’s! [i]Rock of Ages 3[/i] features the longest campaign in the series to date, chock full of ACE Team’s quirky, Monty Python-esque humor. The story will take players through Elpenor’s journey, the lesser-known companion of Odysseus as he wanders through time with the titular “Rock of Ages”, a sentient boulder who will battle famous and infamous figures throughout history in frantic boss battles across 60+ levels.

[i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] is the result of over eight years of development, refinement, and fun rolled up into one package – and with the addition of the robust course creator and the ability to share your creations with the community, the gameplay possibilities are limitless. Pick it up today!

[previewyoutube=UI2QiMSlhz0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Here’s a Look at the All New Course Creator in Rock of Ages 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/2cb6e79bc68714f6b257db04911dfd105bc30543.jpg[/img]

We have spent the last several blogs discussing the all of the ways you will be able to break things in Rock of Ages 3, from the new boulders that will be available to the new ways you will be able to defend your castle from incoming boulders. But it’s called [i]Rock of Ages 3: MAKE & Break[/i], and we haven’t spent enough time talking showing you how you will be able to make amazing custom courses! 

But before we get into, check out some these amazing community created courses from the Rock of Ages 3 open beta! 

[previewyoutube=F53n-VsltD4;full][/previewyoutube]

All of these courses were created using Rock of Ages 3’s brand new custom course creator that allows you to bring your wildest ideas for Rock of Ages courses to life! 

[h3]Create Your Course:[/h3]

First, you will need to select the game mode. You can create custom courses across the various game modes in Rock of Ages 3, including War, Obstacle Course, and the brand new Humpty Dumpty mode. Read about all the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1101360/announcements/detail/2224158720768561864]new game modes coming to Rock of Ages 3 here[/url].

After selecting your game mode, it’s time to start creating your course. Your track is the heart and soul of your custom course, so laying the path of destruction from the starting line to the castle doors is definitely the place to start! In the course creator, you have full control over the height, pitch, width, and length of your track. Additionally, players have the ability to add jumps and steep drops. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/PJQBJhS.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/PJQBJhS.gif[/img][/url]

Once you lay the track, you can add defensive units to thwart your attacker’s attempt to siege your castle doors! Build walls, strategically place canons, and take advantage of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1101360/announcements/detail/2238798603684335288]all the new defensive units[/url]. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/bf3d189fceb17e2f6b9fd68ab1e9ec58e7f43d69.jpg[/img]

[h3]Choose Your Theme[/h3]

From there, you can add theme related obstacles to your course, like statues, trimmed horse hedges, pottery, and, of course, giant mounds of spaghetti. Here are the available themes:
[list]
[*] Wonderland
[*] Tenochtitlan
[*] Switzerland
[*] Rome
[*] Moscow
[*] Planet of the Monkeys
[*] Mongol Empire
[*] India
[*] France
[*] Cyclopean Isles
[*] Spaghettiland
[*] English Channel
[*] China Sea
[/list]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/mi04eI8.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/mi04eI8.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Share Your Course[/h3]

Once you have created your course, it’s time to share it to the world! When you publish your course, it will immediately become available for other Rock of Ages 3 players to play by going to the [i]Break -> Community Levels[/i] section of the menu and choosing your course. Players can search by game type and creator code. Your creator code is a unique code assigned to your course that can be shared with friends so that they can easily find your new creation! 

[h3]Pre-Order Rock of Ages 3 Now![/h3]

The course creator in [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] adds unprecedented replayability to a franchise that already offered over-the-top fun! Test your creativity when the game launches July 21 on PC, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch. [url=https://modusgames.com/rock-of-ages-3/#preorder-section]Pre-order the game now[/url]!

notes.title: Check Out the New Defensive Units Available in Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e59ca29a54412c68a9dc703505de7ae3b5c224ba.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e59ca29a54412c68a9dc703505de7ae3b5c224ba.jpg[/img][/url]

Over the past several weeks, we’ve taken a look at the [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-story-characters/]over-the-top world[/url] of Rock of Ages 3, as well as the new [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-make-and-break-new-boulders-game-modes/]boulders and game modes[/url] coming to this next iteration in July. But Rock of Ages isn’t just about barreling your enormous boulder downhill at your enemy’s castle. It’s also an equally wacky tower defense game! 

So, naturally, we need to take a look at all of the new tools at your disposal to stop the boulder-rolling madness and defend your castle. Here are the new defensive units available in [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i]. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/XtRhw1t.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/dC4IHKr.gif[/img][/url]

[b]War Elephant[/b] – What could be scarier than a massive elephant staring you down in the middle of an open field? A massive elephant carrying archers hell-bent to shoot any boulder that dares to get close.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/D1oT52r.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xLCDY2x.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Guillotine[/b] – Known as “The National Razor” in France, the guillotine was last used for capital punishment in 1977. But in 2020, this deadly apparatus will deal critical damage to a boulder that rolls under it. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/W4X63FS.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/liMBPxU.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Wheel of Pain[/b] – If the Wheel of Fortune had an evil twin, it would be the Wheel of Pain. It’s spinning arms deal serious damage and can send a boulder careening off the side of the map. Attack the center to destroy. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/CDNicbc.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xP5AURZ.gif[/img][/url]

[b]The Fool[/b] – If staying out of the way of a boulder barreling down a hill at terminal velocity is wrong, the fool does not want to be right. Create a congregation of fools, and you now have a slightly larger minor inconvenience. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2fa647160aa63a5f5f3bc0ce3d7371fca99d36ae.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2fa647160aa63a5f5f3bc0ce3d7371fca99d36ae.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Trojan Horse[/b] – Don’t look a gift horse in the mouth? More like don’t look a gift horse in the hollowed-out underbelly filled with enemy combatants! Block your opponents from being able to build on certain parts of their course with the oldest trick in the book. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/wbI3zmv.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/CVkBCHM.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Yeti[/b] – As if the abominable snowman wasn’t terrifying enough, the yeti in Rock of Ages 3 has harnessed the power of winter and delivers an icy blow that freezes nearby boulders. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/bdb2464796831ca79f229024915b2e73cc8136ab.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/bdb2464796831ca79f229024915b2e73cc8136ab.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Battering Ram[/b] – A slow moving, heavy structure that packs a serious punch. Use the battering ram to deal damage and knock back incoming boulders. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/2X3onw9.mp4][img]https://i.imgur.com/V1QUtpG.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Bumper Frog[/b] – Ranidaphobics beware. This gigantic frog will ruin your boulder’s day by inflating to repel attackers. Land on it from above, and it will explode! 

On top of these new additions, staples from previous games are also returning, including walls, launch pads, explosive barrels, and much much more! 

[h3]Preorder Rock of Ages 3 Today! [/h3]
[i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i] launches on July 21, 2020 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC, and Stadia. notes.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break: New Boulders and Game Modes
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/47219c6178941070299d9d9c76da85cfd9781e58.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/47219c6178941070299d9d9c76da85cfd9781e58.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

The [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make and Break[/i] launch is fast approaching. We recently [url=https://modusgames.com/news/rock-of-ages-3-story-characters/]previewed the story[/url] and introduced you to several characters you will encounter when playing through the campaign. This week we want to focus on what makes Rock of Ages 3 well… rock: the boulders!

[h3]Brand New Boulders of Destruction[/h3]
While there will be plenty of familiar faces (did you catch this subtle rock pun) returning in Rock of Ages 3, there will be plenty of new weapons of mass destruction at your disposal. Here’s a preview of the boulders that will be available when the game launches this June.  

[b]Cheese Wheel:[/b] Striking fear into castle gates and the lactose intolerant, the giant cheese wheel is one of the faster boulders and offers better stability than the prehistoric wheel due to its wider base.  

[url=https://i.imgur.com/B5VWPgv.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZFjECL1uIRwgFJVXwE/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Giant Meatball:[/b] Is it spicy? We don’t know. But we do know that it gets bigger when it takes damage! And the bigger it gets, the more damage it deals at the end of its run. 

[b]Snow Boulder:[/b] A rolling stone gathers no moss, and a rolling snow ball loses mass as time goes by. What you lose in size as you go downhill, you make up for in being impervious to many projectiles. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2eb7540f6d494ad520e1de47da1465dffb545bc3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/2eb7540f6d494ad520e1de47da1465dffb545bc3.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Fist Boulder:[/b] You’ve heard of the iron fist, but do you know the stone fist? After jumping, this mighty knuckle sandwich releases a shockwave that does damage to nearby units. 

[b]Sheep Boulder:[/b] Baa baa black sheep have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir… a homogenous blob of sheep which includes copious amounts of wool… full. It’s light, so it covers great distances in the air. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/94t6I8r.mp4][img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/W2civnuddOnjldZntN/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Humpty Dumpty (Only Available in the Humpty Dumpty Game Mode):[/b] If you think rolling an enormous egg down a hill laden with obstacles was a bad idea, you’d be absolutely right! Humpty Dumpty is difficult to maneuver and breaks after just two hits, but try to tell us that gif isn’t hilarious. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/wVMq83P.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QAJqLV0DiDvzqnL6v2/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

Returning boulders from Rock of Ages 2 include: Rock of Ages, Lion Boulder, Medusa's Boulder, Block of Ages, Armored Boulder, Globus Cruciger, Gunpowder Boulder, Fire Boulder, Angel Boulder, Globe, Sand Boulder, Pre-Historic Wheel, and Tar Boulder. 

[h3]New Ways to Play[/h3]
Rock of Ages 3 doesn’t just have new boulders, there are also three brand new game modes where you’ll be able to enjoy once the game launches. 

[b]Humpty Dumpty Mode:[/b] In the new Humpty Dumpty game mode, classic Rock of Ages action meets platforming. You will take control of the Humpty Dumpty boulder in uniquely themed courses as you race from start to finish. Two hits and Humpty Dumpty breaks, but there are checkpoints and extra lives you can pick up as you go.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/5UfQbL6.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KAdwMNxTnmT60NCtn1/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[b]Avalanche:[/b] Defend your castle in this new strategy mode. During the build phase, you will construct robust defenses to fend off dozens of small and large boulders, as well as bombs, released to destroy your fortress. Since this mode does not have the Boulder phase like traditional war mode, you can equip more units and build far more defenses. 

[b]Level Creator:[/b] New to [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] is the level creator which will add endless replayability. Design your most over-the-top courses using the advanced design tool and easily share them with friends! More information on this to come. 

Returning game modes include: War, Obstacle Course, Time Trial, and Skeeball

[h3]Preorder Rock of Ages 3 Now![/h3]
Take all of these new boulders for a test drive down the course when [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] launches on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Stadia on June 2. notes.title: Introducing the Story and Characters of Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e2a0d22a07e3804224a3ddc65d6d3bf93afca26c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/e2a0d22a07e3804224a3ddc65d6d3bf93afca26c.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

The Rock of Ages series has always had over-the-top, wacky humor and stories and Rock of Ages 3 continue that fine tradition! Rock of Ages 3 takes you on a wild adventure in the shoes of Odysseus, or... well his boat anyway. Whether this is your first venture into the series or you’re a returning fan, Rock of Ages doubles down on the beloved formula with the longest story to date and more content than ever before, making it the perfect standalone experience. If you're not all caught up on the game yet, you can learn more about the basics [u]here[/u]. 

Let's take a look at the world, story, and characters you will find in Rock of Ages 3. (Spoiler alert: It’s as bizarre as you remember.)

[h3]A Hero’s Beginning... and End[/h3]
Rock of Ages 3’s story picks up right in the middle of one of Odysseus’s classic adventures, as he raids the cave of a giant cyclops named Polyphemus. When Polyphemus returns to the cave, Odysseus fools him, leaving the cyclops blind.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/63ef1d21007aed94863a3c132b471461ba83a527.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/63ef1d21007aed94863a3c132b471461ba83a527.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

The next morning, Odysseus manages to escape the cave as the cyclops lets his sheep out to graze. While he and his men sail away, Polyphemus hurls boulders into the sea hoping to thwart their escape. Finally, he hurls the ubiquitous Rock of Ages, sinking the fleeing vessel and flattening Odysseus.

With the traditional hero of the story now quite literally swimming with the fishes, you will assume control over Odysseus’s lesser-known sidekick, Elpenor. A curse that Polyphemus asks his father Poseidon to place on Elpenor and his crew will force them to sail the seven seas, encountering characters from all over the world and from multiple eras of history.

[h3]Iconic Cast of Characters[/h3]
As Elpenor and his cursed crew adventure across the world and time, they will be forced to battle historical leaders, mythical gods, heroes made famous through art history, and a few irreverent characters from folklore. Here’s a look at just a few of characters players will fight throughout the game:
[list][*][b]Julius Caesar: [/b]Rome’s most famous emperor, known for his laurel wreath and dying at the end of that Shakespeare play.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/b78b333b411042a8975cfddf0356aff848be4bf0.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/b78b333b411042a8975cfddf0356aff848be4bf0.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[*][b]Moctezuma:[/b] Aztec ruler of Tenochtitlan. Known mostly for his revenge. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/ly0TyRR.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WnOnX6mM2XXoB7NKnM/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[*][b]Rasputin:[/b] The Russian mystic who survived being poisoned and shot three times, only to be killed after his assassin’s threw his body into an icy river. He may or may not have been raised from the dead.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/10210273305e71b2a9a36bba168b778471bdd892.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35637407/10210273305e71b2a9a36bba168b778471bdd892.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Click the image to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[*][b]Krampus:[/b] Half goat. Half demon. All rockstar. A foil to Santa, this figure of central European mythology is sent to punish children that misbehave.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/nf6bHsN.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y4sgNEZymfxkv0Rvnd/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[*][b]Genghis Khan:[/b] History’s most ruthless leader. Mongol conqueror. Iconic moustache.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/2sRURlc.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/U8ZAMXBT0eHqOYT3c9/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]

[*][b]Queen Elizabeth:[/b] The Queen of England and Scotland. Last in the line of Tudors. Prequel to Queen Elizabeth II.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/EUAbpCr.mp4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/duvBj9RIktCUTqSEEb/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view it in higher resolution.[/i]
[/list]
This is just a sample of the characters you will encounter as you journey through the world of Rock of Ages 3!

[h3]Play Rock of Ages 3 June 2nd[/h3]
Experience Elpenor’s story when [i]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/i] launches on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Google Stadia on June 2. Click [url=https://rockofages3.com/]here[/url] to learn more about the game, wishlist on Steam, and preorder today!

notes.title: Closed Alpha FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35637407/47647f06e746aba5a06097fe01c5f75e8a4fff7e.jpg[/img]

The Rock of Ages 3 Closed Alpha on Steam begins [b]tomorrow, Friday Jan 10[/b]! If you haven’t signed up yet, make sure to go do so now at https://rockofages3.com

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JY2B-hIeyiM
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3]When is the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
We will send out emails with Steam codes to anyone accepted to participate starting on Friday, Jan 10 at approximately 9am Pacific Time. At that time you will be able to download the game build from Steam and start playing until we officially end the Closed Alpha test on Jan 13 at 9pm Pacific Time.

[h3]How do I get into the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
Sign up to join through the Rock of Ages 3 website here: [b]https://rockofages3.com[/b] . If you are selected to join the Closed Alpha, you will receive an email on Jan 10 with a Steam key to join the Closed Alpha and download the game from Steam.

[h3]How do I get the Retro Boulder and Guinea Pig Banner for playing the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
You will automatically get the Retro Boulder and Guinea Pig Banner in Rock of Ages 3 by simply adding the Closed Alpha to your Steam library by using the Steam key you receive in your email inbox and launching the Rock of Ages 3 Closed Alpha build between Jan 10 and Jan 13. Our database will record your Steam ID and grant you the bonus items when the full game launches later this year. Both items will be available to use during the Closed Alpha as well.

[h3]Will any progress and levels I make carry over to the final game?[/h3]
We plan to keep any user created levels from the Closed Alpha to be playable and editable by you in the final game, however if we make major changes to the game’s code that may change. You will not retain any campaign progress in the final game because the campaign is not included in the Closed Alpha.

[h3]What is an ‘alpha’?[/h3]
An alpha is a very early version of a game and is missing core features as well as final levels of visual, audio, and gameplay quality. For example, levels may be missing textures, music or even certain gameplay content. For this alpha, many of the menus are placeholder, and a large portion of the game (the campaign and certain game modes) are not included. The levels and content that is available is considered a work in progress and not necessarily representative of the final game product.

[h3]Why are you doing a Closed Alpha?[/h3]
We want to make sure we test some of the online functionality of the game, and also wanted to make sure we got significant feedback on one of the core new features of Rock of Ages 3 – the level creator! We are considering this a ‘Closed’ Alpha because that enables us to limit the number of people with access to the game in order to ensure we test what we need to.

[h3]How can I give you feedback?[/h3]
If you are accepted to the Closed Alpha, there will be a link to a game survey on the main menu of the game that you can follow to provide us with feedback.

[h3]Why should I play the Closed Alpha?[/h3]
If you would like to get an early look at the game and help us to make sure that the final product is as fun as possible, then you should sign up for the Closed Alpha and complete our survey once you’ve played it.

[h3]Is there an NDA or any restrictions on streaming or recording the game?[/h3]
We do not have an NDA in place for the Closed Alpha so you may capture and stream content from the game. We do ask that you ensure that any screenshots or video content that you share does not obscure, remove, or crop out the Alpha Content disclaimer that will be present in the build. This is to ensure that anyone viewing the content is aware that the final game will be significantly more complete than this Alpha version.

[h3]I heard there is a level creator contest. How do I join?[/h3]
We’ve partnered with the Super Mario Maker 2 Discord community to run a level editor contest during the Alpha and ensure that we get feedback from the best level editors around. If you would like to join their contest, please join [url=https://discord.gg/HYeXx28]their Discord server[/url] and check out the announcements channel.

[h3]Where can I report a bug?[/h3]
Join our official Discord server and head over to the Rock of Ages 3 channel! Join link: www.modus.games/discord

notes.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9399/7c60a5752b928874e8a1d81165f1251a23264dc8.png[/img]

[h1]Make your own levels. Break everyone else’s.[/h1]

We're happy to announce our latest installment in the historically accurate boulder smashing series Rock of Ages!

[i][b]Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break[/b][/i] is competitive tower defense and arcade action rolled up with ACE Team's quirky, Monty Python-esque humor into one giant, creative game for the ages.

Jump into the expansive, gut-busting story for an eclectic adventure featuring bizarre and irreverent takes on legendary characters, or for the first time, create and share your own levels to compete with friends and strangers online in a real-time mix of hectic tower defense and epic boulder-racing arcade action.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DDA5iYi_TAU
[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Make & Break Worlds:[/b] Design and build your own levels in the easy-to-use editor and share your creations with players from all over the world for nearly limitless creative fun!

[*][b]Competitive Tower Defense:[/b] Build defenses and race to destroy your opponents’ in up to 4-player online multiplayer, or head-to-head in 2-player split-screen action.

[*][b]Boulder-Smashing Arcade Action:[/b] Crash your way through everything in your path as fast as you can in six distinct and arcadey game modes with over 20 zany boulders!

 [*][b]Absurdly Funny:[/b] Take a ride on the wild side with ACE Team's hilarious story – everyone from Caesar and Moctezuma to Krampus and the Spaghetti Monster make an appearance in an expansive campaign across history and beyond.

 [*][b]Game Modes Galore:[/b] Defend your base in the new Boulder Avalanche, perfect your rolling skills in the fragile Humpty-Dumpty Mode, race the clock in Time Trials, or create your own unique gameplay with the creator for hundreds of hours of fun!
[/list]

Official website: RockOfAges3.com

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/
